section_summary.extract_value: This convergent validity section reports that the Polish BAS-2 demonstrated good convergent validity. For the whole sample and separately for men and women, BAS-2 (body appreciation) correlated positively with self-esteem, body-related hubristic and authentic pride, positive affect, and positive orientation, and was significantly negatively associated with body-related shame, body-related guilt, and BMI. The section references Table 2 and notes gender-separated analyses but does not report sample size, demographics, or numeric correlation coefficients.
section_summary.evidence_source: The Polish BAS-2 scores showed good convergent validity (Table 2). For the whole group, as well for men and women separately, body appreciation was significantly and positively correlated with self-esteem, body-related hubristic pride, body-related authentic pride, positive affect, and positive orientation. BAS-2 scores were significantly and negatively associated with body-related shame, body-related guilt, and BMI.
